svg.text: Share your biodata: the full journey
From the admin's button to a new person joining, in order. Web only. Numbers in the last step are sample numbers.
On a user's row in the Users list, the admin
presses Send share link. Only users with an
email get it. The button can be pressed again
The email has one button. It opens her share
settings inside her normal Bohra Taaruf
account. No code or OTP: she logs in as usual
and lands on the right page.
She sees one master switch, her links and
how each is doing. Switching it off ends every
link at once. Up to 5 active links; more on
1 person joined Bohra Taaruf from this link
Every detail we hold has a switch. Name: first
or full. Photo: blurred or hers. She can add her
native place…). A tip says: no phone or email.
Please do not put your phone number or
email in your bio. Anyone with the link can read it.
She names it so she remembers who has it. Then
she picks how long it works. One view only is
first and recommended. The others are 24 hours,
One tap copies the link or opens WhatsApp with a
ready message. Because a one-view link is spent
when opened, we remind her: open it in the
One-time link. Open it in their browser,
not inside WhatsApp. We add this reminder
to the WhatsApp message for you.
Sees a small card in chat
WhatsApp shows a small card. It always shows
only a first name, age, city and a blurred photo,
even if her page shows more, because chat cards
On desktop or phone. It shows only what she
chose, with a blurred photo or the one she picked.
No phone, email or ITS number is ever shown.
At the bottom: find more such profiles, Join.
The Join button opens the normal signup page
with a hidden code for that link. We save the
code with the new account. After signup,
everything works as it does today.
You came from a shared biodata
Let the person who shared it know I joined
Default: she is told only the link's name, no name.
If the new person ticked the box, she sees their
first name. Nothing is shown if she switched
sharing off or stopped that link.
Activity shows each open: time, phone type, app,
and the link's status. We cannot tell who opened
it. She can stop one link, or switch off all sharing
Only totals: emails sent, links made, opens and
signups from shared links. No names. Button taps
and email opens live in Vercel and MSG91, not
PHASE 1 · The invite and her settings
PHASE 2 · Making a link and sending it
If sharing is switched off, or a link is stopped, expired or already used, the visitor sees: "This link is switched off or has ended", plus the Join promo.
